findings.problem: 'bill unknown' → bare «неизвестно» drops the billing subject; at the 12-cell rung it reads as a generic 'unknown' and no longer says it is the charge that is unknown (the note requires the cancellation/billing reason to survive).
No plural branch, but genitive plural «срочных» is ungrammatical for 1/21 («1 срочных»); same for ask_queue.waiting_clause «{shown} ждут» («1 ждут»). Use a count-neutral label form.
Context says the heading is a noun, not a verb; «завершены» is a predicate (short participle, 'are settled').

The RU-002 fix is grammatical now, but «срочно:» is an adverb ('urgently: 2'). The usual Russian count-label form is the genitive plural before a colon (as in «ещё задач: {count}»). The sibling «ждут: {shown}» keeps a plural verb, so «ждут: 1» still jars a little.
findings.disposition: open at PASS: minor/nit accepted, value unchanged
